seo.title: About Kancil Pintar
seo.description: Kancil Pintar is a personal site for practising OSN PAUD and TK questions at home.

hero.title: Built for studying at home
hero.lead: A personal project: turning a stack of practice papers into something a child can work through on a screen, without printing anything.

mascot.title: Why a kancil?
mascot.body: The kancil, or mouse-deer, is the clever one in Indonesian folk tales — not the biggest or the fastest, but the one who thinks. Good company for a child working out an answer.

sections.heading: Why this exists
body: The OSN practice papers for PAUD and TK circulate as Word documents and PDFs. That is fine for printing, but awkward when a child wants to work through them again and again.
This site rebuilds those papers as one question per screen, with the answer marked straight away so it can be talked about on the spot.

sections.heading: Who it is for
body: Children from PAUD through TK B, working alongside a parent or teacher. Most questions are pictures, but the wording still needs reading aloud.

sections.heading: How the questions are prepared
body: The questions, options and pictures are read off the printed pages of the original files and rebuilt as structured data.
The answer key comes from the coloured highlight the original files already carry — it is read, not guessed.
list: Pictures are cut from the printed page rather than redrawn.
The answer highlight is erased from the pictures before they are shown.
Questions that could not be read in full are recorded, but not shown.

sections.heading: Where it stops
body: This site does not run a competition and does not speak for anyone. What it offers is practice material — not predicted questions, and not a promise of any result.
If an answer looks wrong to you, say so on the contact page and it will be checked against the original.

about.disclaimer: Kancil Pintar is not affiliated with the {organiser} organisers, is not sponsored by them, and has no official relationship with them.

compliance.disclaimer: Kancil Pintar is a personal project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the {organiser} organisers. No certification, accreditation or award is claimed anywhere on this site.

table.caption: Counted from the site's own content

sections.heading: Where the content comes from
body: The questions, options and pictures come from publicly circulating OSN PAUD and TK practice papers, distributed as Word and PDF files. That material is not our work.
It is used here for study, free of charge. If you hold the rights to it and object, send a message from the contact page and the material will be taken down.

sections.heading: How the answer key is decided
body: The original files mark the correct option with a coloured highlight. That mark is what is read, option by option, off the printed page.
list: No highlight means the question is not shown.
An ambiguous highlight means the question is not shown.
Options that could not be read in full mean the question is not shown.
The highlight is erased from the pictures before they are displayed, so it cannot give the answer away.

sections.heading: Accuracy
body: The content is checked by comparing the rebuilt questions against the original pages, but not every question has been reviewed one by one by a person.
The key here therefore follows the original file, including where the original is itself mistaken. Corrections are very welcome.

sections.heading: Scores and assessment
body: A session's score is simply the number of correct answers divided by the number of questions. It is not an official mark, not a ranking, and not compared with other users.
No claim is made that practising here improves anyone's chances in any competition.

sections.heading: Data and children
body: This site asks for no name, no age, no email address and no personal data at all, from either the child or the adult.
Practice records are kept only in the browser storage of the device in use, and can be deleted at any time from the practice page.

sections.heading: Accessibility
body: The site uses semantic landmarks, high contrast, a skip link, and honours the operating system's reduced-motion setting.
No formal WCAG audit has been carried out, so no conformance level is claimed here.

sections.heading: Changes
body: Any change to a code rule, a feature or the content must update this page and both interface languages in the same change.

seo.title: Privacy policy
seo.description: No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Practice records stay on your own device.

hero.title: We collect nothing
hero.lead: The short version: no accounts, no trackers, and nothing sent to a server of ours.

sections.heading: What is collected
body: Nothing. This site has no sign-up form, runs no analytics, and stores no visitor data on a server.

sections.heading: What is stored on your device
body: Two things live in your browser's local storage, and never leave the device:
list: Practice session history: which paper, how many correct, and when.

sections.heading: Deleting it
body: The clear button on the practice page removes it immediately. Clearing site data in your browser settings removes it too.

sections.heading: Third parties
body: The typefaces on this site load from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google's servers when a page loads.
Beyond that, no third-party service is called from these pages.

sections.heading: Contact
body: The contact form opens your own email application. No message passes through a server of ours. What you do send by email is of course readable by us as the recipient.

sections.heading: Children
body: The site is meant to be used by a child together with an adult. Since no data is collected, no child's data is held by us either.
